app.notes:
The Mixer's Guide melody button, scoring and the pitch guide now use the same Melody Channel as the Guide, in every song
Before, some songs called another part, such as the piano, the Guide melody, so muting it there muted the wrong instrument
Mic-Key now looks for a new version each time you come back to it, and the update notice on Home stays until you install it
